name: retail-locator-usa
description: Interactive US retail store locator web app. Requires Node.js 18+ and the my_pois.csv dataset in the repo root.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend" --names fe,be --prefix-colors cyan,yellow
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
